summary: Check-Cap Ltd filed a Form 6-K providing financial statements and pro forma information related to its pending merger with MBody AI Corp. The merger, approved by shareholders on November 14, 2025, will see CC Merger Sub Inc. merge with and into MBody AI, with MBody AI surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary. The merger is expected to close in the first half of 2026, subject to conditions including sufficient capital for Nasdaq listing and regulatory reviews. No deal terms such as price per share or premium were disclosed. The filing includes audited financials of MBody AI and unaudited pro forma combined financials. Risk-arb observers should watch for Nasdaq compliance and regulatory approvals.
